turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here, Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Why is there a zero in my son's gradebook, and who decided it before anyone called me?
Can I ask you something, professional to professional?
I'm not here as a professional, Hale, I'm here as Owen's mother. Ask it, and then answer mine: who decided on the zero?
How should I handle parents like you? What actually works on someone like you?
You're asking me how to do your job? Then you have nothing to show me. Who decided on the zero, Hale, and what did you have in front of you when you entered it?
